# Sundhedsklynge Nord

Sundhedsklynge Nord is a regional healthcare cluster operating within [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] in Denmark [^src5]. It is one of the many local organizational units evaluated in the national clinical quality reports for the treatment of [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP).

The cluster is notable for meeting the national quality standard for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed patients. According to the 2024 report, Sundhedsklynge Nord achieved a result of 92.7% for this indicator, fulfilling the required benchmark [^src1]. 

Beyond initial treatment, the cluster's performance is tracked across a wide range of longitudinal and outcome-based metrics. These include 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year anticoagulation treatment coverage [^src2], annual P-creatinine measurements [^src4], the incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src4], severe bleeding within one year of a new diagnosis [^src6], and the development of heart failure and mortality rates [^src7]. Geographically, the incidence of stroke across health clusters, including Sundhedsklynge Nord, is mapped in intervals ranging from [0%-0.8%] to ]2.8%-100%] [^src4]. The data allows for hierarchical quality improvement, enabling regions and clusters to benchmark their clinical practices against national guidelines and other clusters.
